content.label: Every parent's question
content.question: How will you manage it all alone?

answers.title: Go by a checklist
answers.detail: Put every task on one list. Tick them off one by one and it all feels manageable.

answers.title: Ask the university
answers.detail: Don't hesitate to ask the international student office for help.

answers.title: A network of seniors
answers.detail: Those who went before you have the most useful experience. Start talking to them now.
